# Recursive Comparable selector factories

Independently authored `Factory<T>` methods shadow the owner formal with their
own method formal. A single contravariant/covariant Function input binds an
invariant Comparator result; its separate key formal retains the complete
recursive Comparable bound. Core also invokes the actual standard-library
factory with the same original contract.

The frozen observer distinguishes eager provider behavior from deferred
standard-library selection, ignored results, key/receiver snapshots, late
returned references, initialization failures and erroneous reuse, callbacks,
comparisons, casts and exact exceptions. Source and SDK-provider profiles compile
all generated Java and compare every original definition, metadata attribute,
runtime role and Exceptions declaration. Wrong programs precede CLI recovery;
Signature-only controls retain unchanged Code.
